The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 46adc5be1070213b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 11. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let e : Y → X be a proper generically finite surjective morphism between connected smooth compact Kähler manifolds. Let L be a pseudo-effective rational line on X, and let F ≥ 0 be a rational divisor on Y . Suppose that on a smooth model over Y , the line e∗L + F is rationally linearly equivalent to its rational negative part. Then there is an effective rational divisor D on X such that L ∼Q D = N(L).
